message.content: Review the M12 diff for CORRECTNESS bugs: logic errors, wrong data flow, missing null/empty handling, off-by-one, incorrect mapping between bookings/sessions/providers, broken links/routes, server/client boundary mistakes (functions passed to client components, server-only imported in client), revalidatePath gaps. The repo is at the cwd, on branch m12-customer-dashboard. Run `git diff main...HEAD` to see the full M12 customer-dashboard diff, and read any changed files for context (use Read/Grep/Bash). Project rules (CLAUDE.md): WCAG 2.2 AA accessibility; external services only via adapters (lib/integrations/*); money in integer cents, pricing only in lib/pricing.ts; RLS on every table; validate at the boundary + check role/ownership in every server action; server-only never in client bundles. Only report REAL, actionable issues INTRODUCED by this diff — not pre-existing code, not style nits. Be specific (file + location). If you find nothing real, return an empty findings array.

findings.title: Receipt download links 404 for any booking without a completed session
findings.detail: The Receipts section renders a "Download receipt" link for EVERY payment row returned by listCustomerPayments (no status filter). But a confirmed/upcoming booking already has a payments row with status "authorized" (created by payments.authorizeHold in app/(customer)/actions.ts at booking time, before any session exists). The receipt route at app/(customer)/account/receipt/[bookingId]/route.ts does `const [booking, session] = await Promise.all([getBooking, getSessionByBooking]); if (!booking || ... || !session) return 404`. Since getSessionByBooking returns null until the session is completed, every authorized-but-not-yet-completed booking produces a visible receipt link that returns HTTP 404 when clicked. A customer who just booked an upcoming session will see a broken download.
findings.suggestion: Only render receipt links for payments tied to completed sessions (e.g. filter to status === "captured", or to bookings that have a completed session), or make the receipt route gracefully handle the no-session case (return a partial/authorized receipt instead of 404).

findings.location: const next = upcoming[0]; (Resume card uses next for `account.nextSession`)
findings.title: "Next session" shows most-recently-created booking, not the soonest-scheduled one
findings.detail: `upcoming` is derived directly from listCustomerBookings, which orders by created_at DESC (lib/db/queries.ts listCustomerBookings). `next = upcoming[0]` is therefore the most recently CREATED confirmed/in_progress booking, not the chronologically next session. With two upcoming bookings — e.g. one scheduled next week (booked today) and one scheduled tomorrow (booked yesterday) — the Resume card labeled "Next session" will show next week's booking. The Upcoming bookings list is likewise displayed in created_at order rather than by scheduled time.
findings.suggestion: Sort upcoming by scheduled_at ascending (treating talk-now/in_progress as soonest) before picking next and before rendering the list, so "Next session" and the list order reflect actual chronology.

findings.location: cancel(id) onClick of the Cancel button
findings.title: Cancel button cancels irreversibly on a single click with no confirmation
findings.detail: Clicking "Cancel" calls cancelBooking immediately. The action can charge the full block per the cancellation policy (cancellationOutcome → capture) when a scheduled session is within 1h of start, so an accidental single click can both cancel the booking and charge the customer. A confirmation string `account.cancelConfirm` ("Cancel this booking?") was added to messages/en.json for exactly this but is never used.
findings.suggestion: Gate the cancel action behind a confirmation (use the existing account.cancelConfirm string via a Dialog/confirm step) before invoking cancelBooking.

content.text:
I've completed the M12 customer-dashboard correctness review. Here's a summary of what I found.

## Findings

**1. (High) Receipt download links 404 for non-completed bookings** — `app/(customer)/account/page.tsx`
The Receipts section renders a "Download receipt" link for every payment with no status filter. Confirmed/upcoming bookings have an `authorized` payment row (created at booking time by `payments.authorizeHold`) but no session yet. The receipt route (`app/(customer)/account/receipt/[bookingId]/route.ts`) returns 404 when `getSessionByBooking` is null, so any just-booked upcoming session shows a broken download link.

**2. (Medium) "Next session" shows wrong booking** — `app/(customer)/account/page.tsx`
`next = upcoming[0]` picks from `listCustomerBookings` which is ordered `created_at DESC`. So the Resume card's "Next session" and the Upcoming list reflect creation order, not scheduled time — a session booked later but scheduled sooner will be hidden behind one scheduled further out.

**3. (Low) Cancel is a single irreversible click that can charge the customer** — `components/customer/UpcomingBookings.tsx`
The Cancel button calls `cancelBooking` immediately; within 1h of a scheduled start this captures the full block. The `account.cancelConfirm` string was added but never wired up.

## Things I verified as correct (not flagged)
- Server/client boundaries: `"use client"` components import the `"use server"` actions correctly; `tsc --noEmit` passes clean.
- All route links use booking ids consistently (`/session/[id]`, `/session/[id]/summary`, `/account/receipt/[bookingId]`) matching the route handlers.
- Ownership/role checks in every action (`requireRole("customer")` + `customer_id` ownership), Zod validation at boundaries, money stays in cents, `cancellationOutcome` from `lib/pricing.ts`.
- `getApprovedProvidersByIds`/`listFavoriteProviders` empty-array handling, null-safe `shortDate`/`durationLabel`, review mapping via `session_id`, and `favorites` unique constraint backing the `addFavorite` upsert.

Note: I noticed the M10 `favorites_set_updated_at` trigger fires `before update` on a table with no `updated_at` column — but that's pre-existing (not in this diff) and isn't exercised by M12's `ignoreDuplicates` upsert, so I left it out of scope.
